newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Amer seen falling to 8-mth loss.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Amer seen falling to 8-mth loss.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a median forecast of a 195 million markka January-August loss after financial items, before extraordinaries for Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy.
The results are due on October 10.
In January-August 1995, Amer posted a 36 million markka profit.
For Amer's full-year 1996 earnings, 10 of the 14 analysts polled gave a median forecast loss of 143 million markka (mean 145 million markka loss) in a 227-80 million markka loss range.
In 1995, Amer had a 140 million markka profit after financial items.
The data was collected in the first two weeks of October.

Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aktia, Alfred Berg, Aros, Carnegie, Enskilda, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities and Opstock.
